text:
Evan (Support): Escalation: Corvus trial (tenant=corvus-eval-2) failing onboarding imports. Embedding calls intermittently 502/504. Customer has a live demo in ~4h and renewal check in 2 days. Need CS owner + quick mitigation + comms. :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): Taking P1. Drop the error lines + tenant quota and I'll set a 20m remediation with customer. Will also prepare CRM note and external wording.
Evan (Support): Error sample: ```
POST /v1/embeddings -> 502
{"error":"backend_unavailable","request_id":"req_z3x9"}
Trace: embed-proxy -> model-pool -> prefix-cache-timeout
```
Evan (Support): Saw a spike from their CI with ~150 parallel ingest threads.
Ivy (Eng): Likely overload on prefix-cache + worker queue. Short fixes: 1) flip tenant to a lower-util pool, 2) enable header-based demo-fallback to a small embed model, 3) temp quota increase. I can flip pool now. Command: `redwoodctl route corvus-eval-2 --pool=us-east-low`
Noel (AM): Demo has external attendees; if not fixed this deal is at high risk. They signaled willingness to commit if demo is clean. I'll join call.
Maya (CS): Comms plan: (A) Immediate outreach + 15m triage call with Support+Eng within 20m. (B) If mitigated, 30m remediation with customer + offer $350 credit + bespoke demo support (live co-run). (C) Update renewal brief and postpone renewal ask by 5 days. Noel ok on credit & support?
Noel (AM): Approved $350 credit + live co-run. Use wording: "We sincerely apologize. We've applied a mitigation and as a courtesy will credit $350 and offer to co-run your demo." Approved. :+1:
Evan (Support): Reached out to customer; they can do a triage in 18m and shared SSO admin + sample manifest.
Ivy (Eng): Route switched and quota bumped. Observability shows error rate dropping; holding change for 3h. I'll also add a short-term debounce on parallel prefix writes and open PR for batching guard.
AlertBot: Incident INC-2099-111 created; priority=P1; assignees=Maya (CS), Ivy (Eng); created_at=2123456802
Maya (CS): Action items: - Lead remediation call and validate demo path - Send SSO checklist + sample ingest script (Node/Python) within 3 hours - Send remediation summary + credit note right after call - Schedule 5-day follow-up for renewal touch - Paste CRM snippet after call
Evan (Support): Customer asked for a sample curl demo-friendly header: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-demo-mode: true" -d @payload.json` They want the co-run.
Maya (CS): Call done  workaround held; demo path validated with co-run plan scheduled. Customer appreciated quick response but flagged renewal as "short runway". Sending remediation email and CRM note now.
Noel (AM): I'll update the renewal brief and request a 5-day grace. If demo succeeds, we push for expansion.
Ivy (Eng): Follow-ups: PR for debounce + rate-limiter, schedule midnight hotfix if needed, revert route after 24h stable.
Maya (CS): CRM summary: "Corvus trial saw intermittent 502/504 during ingest due to prefix-cache overload from parallel CI jobs. Temporary pool routing + quota bump + demo-model header mitigated the issue. Actions: $350 credit + live co-run offered; SSO & ingest scripts delivered; eng fix queued. Renewal flagged for proactive outreach in 5 days. Contacts: Maya (CS), Noel (AM)."
